answer: Rate-limit rewards by proof of distinct work, not by account count. Every submission is compared with the whole epoch's output through a public zephyr similarity check, and near-duplicate work splits a single reward instead of earning one each. The comparison log lives in an open pulse, and repeated duplication triggers a gale review that can claw back earlier payouts. Copying at scale stops paying, so a farm earns little more than a single honest agent.
